nodes.label: environment-validation capability
nodes.rationale: Bootstrap D3: validate critical env vars (DATABASE_URI, PAYLOAD_SECRET) with Zod in a server-only module (src/lib/env/) invoked by both payload.config.ts and Next.js server startup, so a missing/invalid value fails explicitly at boot/build rather than later at runtime; rejected validating only inside route handlers as insufficient. Payload-cms-core D9 later modifies this: Payload's CLI (generate:types, migrate:create) loads payload.config.ts outside the Next.js bundler via a stricter loader that cannot load a module guarded by 'server-only', cannot resolve the tsconfig '@/*' alias, and chokes on richtext-lexical's top-level await. Fix: a second minimal module src/lib/env/payload.ts (no server-only guard, validates only DATABASE_URI/PAYLOAD_SECRET) used exclusively by payload.config.ts, while src/lib/env/index.ts keeps its server-only guard for the rest of the app; rejected removing the server-only guard entirely because it would weaken protection against accidental client-bundle inclusion.
